name: athkatla
lore:
### Athkatla: The City of Coin

To the uninitiated, **Athkatla** is a dazzling tapestry of opulence and ambition. As the capital of Amn, it stands as the wealthiest port on the Sword Coast—a place where every breath has a price and every soul a value.

#### History
The city’s ascent was forged not by kings, but by merchant lords. Following the collapse of the Shoon Imperium, Athkatla emerged as a sovereign power governed by the **Council of Six**—an anonymous body of oligarchs who prioritize profit above all else. Its stone streets have survived plagues, internal coups, and divine upheavals, always rebuilt with thicker gold leaf than before.

#### Significance
Athkatla is a titan of global commerce. The **Waukeen’s Promenade**, a marketplace of staggering scale, offers wonders from across Toril. However, travelers must heed the **Edict of Arcana**: unsanctioned magic is a capital crime. This law is ruthlessly enforced by the **Cowled Wizards**, a shadowy cabal that hunts "deviant" casters with terrifying efficiency. In this city, coin buys protection, but hubris buys a cell in the asylum of Spellhold.

#### Legends
Whispers haunt the docks, speaking of the **Shadow Thieves**, a guild so pervasive they are said to own the very shadows the Council walks upon. Darker legends suggest the city’s foundations rest upon the ruins of an ancient, cursed empire, its restless spirits pacified only by the constant, rhythmic clink of gold.

***Scholar’s Note:*** *Keep your purse tight and your wand hidden. In the City of Coin, the only true sin is poverty.*
